item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-14

item.title: [Brainstorm] Project Matchmaker — An Agent-Assisted Collaboration Network for the CKB Ecosystem (4 posts)
item.description: During a brainstorming session with Matt, Shawn, Leigh, Yukun and a few others, I brought up an idea that I think could be worth exploring. We have quite a few promising projects and talented developers across the CKB ecosystem, but many of them are working in relative isolation. Sometimes two teams are solving closely related problems without knowing it. Other times, a project needs precisely the expertise that somebody elsewhere in the community already has. What if we built a platform that continuously looks for these connections? Let’s call it Project Matchmaker for now. This is just a brainstorming proposal, not an agreed roadmap. item.title: Spark Program | CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint：可复现的 RISC-V 语义差分工具、Lean 4 证明与 Rocq/Coq 兼容性 Spike (1 posts)
item.description: 跟社区同步一下 CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint 的交付进展。week6-0.2.0 已经发布，代码、证据和复现说明都在公开仓库。先说清楚范围：这是重新申请时约定的六周 MVP，不是整个 CKB-VM 的正确性证明。 1. 差分工具：33 个案例逐步一致 在固定的 CKB-VM VERSION2 Rust 解释器和 Sail RISC-V 模型之间，对同一条注入指令流逐步比较提交效果。ADD 13、ADDI 10、BEQ 10，共 33 个案例、398 步全部一致，每个案例都能单独重放。比较器本身也测过：往轨迹里注入 6 类错误共 194 次，全部被检出并定位到字段。 对维护者来说，它能告诉你两边从哪一步、哪个字段开始分歧，并保留可重放的输入；但它不保证语料之外没有缺陷。 想自己跑一下（需要已装好 Rust、OPAM 和常规构建依赖；第一次要从源码构建 Sail，耗时看机器和网络）： git clone --recursive https://github.com/TinyuengKwan/ckb-vm-sail-verify && cd ckb-vm-sail-verify git checkout week6-0.2.0 && git submodule update --init --recursive make ckb-baseline-apply make sail-compiler && export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/sail-src/bin:$PATH" make verify-env &&...

item.title: Noir-CKB update: what I decided after the direction check, what you can try today, and where this is going (1 posts)
item.description: About a month ago I shared a direction check here for noir-ckb, asking for feedback on what I was building. I got really thoughtful replies, mostly around two questions: Where should a proof live in a CKB transaction (Lock or Type?), and is Noir → Groth16 even the right backend, given its per-circuit trusted setup. This post is the follow-up: what I decided, what exists now that you can actually run (including on testnet), and the longer-term picture of where I want this to go. It’s a long one, sorry in advance Quick recap, if you’re new to this noir-ckb lets you write a rule in Noir, prove it off-chain, and have a CKB script verify the proof. item.title: Tactus O1: First Based EVM Rollup on CKB (1 posts)
item.description: A follow-up on Tactus O1. The latest experiments exposed two problems I need to address. Generating a ZK proof took roughly 78 minutes on my laptop, while verification on CKB consumed about 3.985 billion cycles, exceeding mainnet’s 3.5 billion limit. The prototype works on a devnet with a higher limit, but is not mainnet-ready. The prover also replays execution history from genesis, so the cost grows as the chain gets longer. The other concern is settlement lag. CKB can keep accepting EVM transaction batches while their proofs are still pending. That means transaction ordering can move ahead of verified settlement, potentially delaying withdrawals indefinitely if proving cannot keep up....
